findingDetails.title: Two sk-doc catalog docs claim a 56-row leaf-route gold while the replay reports 59
findingDetails.evidence: leaf-route-replay.md:26 and feature-catalog.md:53 both state the replay scores 'the 56-row committed gold'; running node .skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/scripts/leaf-route-replay.cjs prints 'total gold=59 scored=58 tied=2 mean_f1=0.9249 exact=52' (exit 0).
findingDetails.scopeProof: repo-wide search for '56-row' finds only these two lines; the replay's total line is the authoritative count and gold rows derive from committed playbook scenario files (leaf-route-replay.cjs:267), so the documented count is stale against disk.
findingDetails.claim: The documented leaf-route gold-row count no longer matches the replay's own total.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Tested whether 56 could count only scored rows (scored=58), only rows with prompt and leaf pairs (gold=59 by the replay's own definition), or a frozen baseline (no committed artifact carries 56).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The count was accurate when written and scenario rows were added later; the deletion removed no gold-carrying scenario and added none, so this is pre-existing drift surfaced by the traceability sweep, not deletion breakage.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If a committed frozen-gold artifact fixes the documented set at 56, the mismatch becomes a deliberate snapshot-naming issue rather than drift; it remains P2 either way.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update both docs to the replay's current total (59) or replace the literal with the replay's 'total gold=' line; if the count is meant to be frozen, name the frozen artifact.
